items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I remember Louis Armstrong, Johnny Tessiturn had Louis Armstrong eat at the Coliseum Arena... Louis Armstrong played the advertisement for him that day.

ctx.x: That's one thing, uh, with the music, between the musicians there, there's no color. Uh-huh. We was on tour, I remember, with a trombone player, formerly of, who was with, uh, Louis Armstrong, uh, for a while. T. Gordon.
